It runs `main(['report', ...])`, asserts the exit code equals EXIT_OK, and asserts the report's model cost line equals '1.00'. `uv run --offline pytest -q tests/test_report_nonfinite_run_cost.py` gave 3 passed. I did not run a mutant to confirm the test fails when non-finite costs are not skipped.
